relationships.subject: COX-2
relationships.evidence_quote: The fourth-ranked enzyme, COX-2, converts endocannabinoids into prostaglandins, occupies a position connecting inflammatory and pain-related pathways (Fowler 2007).

key_findings: Network analysis (80 nodes, 218 edges) ranks CB1, TRPV1, PPARα, COX-2, GPR55 as top betweenness nodes; CB1 removal raises CB2 and GPR55 prominence.
